_doc: Samsung Trade-In max published values per model id (Samsung's credits are promotional and tied to buying a new Galaxy, so the value is the HIGHEST credit Samsung currently lists for the model across its offers). Refreshed weekly by scripts/refresh-samsung-comps.py via .github/workflows/refresh-comps.yml (its old URL now 404s, see _verification). Frontend reads this at runtime when device is in the Samsung family (android / samsung_tab / samsung_pc / samsungwatch). CONVENTION: only include a value Samsung actually lists. notAccepted = model ids a manual check confirmed Samsung does NOT take; only those get the 'Samsung won't take this on trade-in' claim. A model with no value and not in notAccepted makes no claim either way.

_verification.2026-09-16: Manual check (Powerhouse). Each value = max of (a) Samsung's own trade-in table served on 2026-09-16 at www.samsung.com/us/consumer/shop/tradeInJson.json (good-condition 'A' credit, highest across storage variants and purchase offers) and (b) the Galaxy Z Fold 8 trade-in list reported by 9to5google on 2026-09-04 (S26 Ultra $800, Z Fold 7 $800, Z Flip 7 $390, Z Fold 6 $550, Z Fold 5 $380, S25 Ultra $680, S25 $350, S23 Ultra $390). Samsung accepts the S26 family, Z Fold 7 and Z Flip 7 (9to5google 2026-07-22 and 2026-09-04).
_verification.flip8List: Samsung's own table has no S25 FE, Z Fold 7, Z Flip 7 or S26 rows, so two values also take the Galaxy Z Flip 8 trade-in lists: gzflip7 = 400 (SamMobile 2026-08-19 'Galaxy Z Flip 7: $400 off'; SammyGuru Flip 8 guide updated 2026-08-07, $400) - the Fold 8's $390 is not the highest; gs25fe = 290 (SammyGuru Fold 8 guide updated 2026-08-14 and Flip 8 guide updated 2026-08-07, both $290). The old gs25fe 95 was a 2026-05-24 snapshot. SamMobile 2026-08-19 also shows Samsung takes the Z Flip 7 FE ($280 toward a Flip 8); one figure only, so no value yet.
_verification.upperBounds: gs26p 700 and gs26 600 are the latest published figures found (Fold 8 pre-order list, 9to5google 2026-07-22); Samsung has cut values since (Flip 8 list 2026-08-19: S26+ $540, S26 $450), so treat them as ceilings.
_verification.unverified: Z TriFold, Z Fold 8 / 8 Ultra and Z Flip 8: no evidence either way, so no value and no claim.
